usage: 蛋黃酥 is a noun used to name a specific type of pastry filled with salted egg yolk.
You can say 蛋黃酥 when ordering dim sum to specify this sweet pastry.
Use 蛋黃酥 to describe the taste or texture when talking about food.
It works as the subject or object in a sentence when you are discussing dim sum choices.
You often hear 蛋黃酥 mentioned in contexts related to snacks, festivals, or dessert menus.
